player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Chopsticks. No turn mo, pili ka met ed saray:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=so kamot mo (0 o 1), O=kamot na kalaban (0 o 1).
    - Labi so kamot na kalaban toon maungay ed kamot mo; no >=5, iton toon 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  a manggawa so total na daliri mo ed L tan R (L+R = so total mo).
Reply ka met ed exactly one na saray komand.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Say kalaban a lima {opp_idx} et inatey la.
invalid_move.split_sum: Say kantidad na divided et nepeg ya {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Nepeg a manguman so panangibunog na lima yo.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Say invalid move. Gawisen so “[attack M O]” o “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} inatake so kamot na P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: iton toon ed {opp_val} to {new_val}.

outcome.win: Amin ya kalaban et inatey la.
outcome.draw: Akasabi la so limitasyon na kalkalnan iyalis.
